title.zh: 前端在线更新与注册、密钥体验改进
title.en: Frontend updates, registration and API key improvements

zh: 新增管理员前端在线更新，可在更新设置中检查并安装界面更新，查看构建进度与失败日志。
新增前端发行说明，在检查更新时展示对应提交的中英文改动记录。
修复启用邮箱验证后无法完成注册的问题，并正确显示验证码重发倒计时。
修复主机刚启动时版本检查可能延迟的问题，首次检查即可获取最新版本信息。
修复创建密钥时桌面端厂商图标与文字挤压的问题，并在手机端使用下拉选择以适应窄屏。
en: Administrators can now check for and install frontend updates from update settings, with build progress and failure logs available.
Added frontend release notes with Chinese and English changes for the checked commit.
Fixed registration failures when email verification is enabled and corrected the countdown for resending verification codes.
Fixed delayed version checks immediately after host startup so the first check can retrieve the latest version information.
Fixed cramped provider icons and text in the API key creation dialog on desktop and added a dropdown selector for narrow mobile screens.
